Name: mariachaaan's Long Hair Olivia Seasonal Cute Edition
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I love love LOVE mariachaaan's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43486]Long Hair Olivia[/url]! But I wanted Seasonal Cute compatibility. mariachaaan gave me permission, and Poltergeister's perms for Seasonal Cute Olivia were open, so here we are! 

To install, just download and merge with your ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE [/url]mod folder and allow to overwrite.

This also includes a download for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43350]Drawberry's Cute Festival Outfits for SVE[/url] for full compat! Just overwrite the original assets for Drawberry's mod as well.

**NOTE: Her hair was left short for Spirit's Eve on purpose, since I felt it fit the Cruella Deville costume better. We'll just say she's wearing a wig lol. 

That's it! Enjoy!
